item.title: Multiple potholes and standing water on Mount Drive (near the golf club entrance and first parking bay), 11th November
item.description:
There are multiple potholes and areas of standing water on Mount Drive. After entering Mount Drive Road and continuing towards the golf club car park, there are many potholes that would benefit from careful inspection.From the entrance onwards there are numerous shallow depressions that hold water. Near the golf barrier in the middle section there are two larger holes, and there are a further two potholes in the first parking bay. These defects have been present for approximately three months.The route is regularly used by residents, including children and older people. The water-filled holes can be difficult to see at night and in the early morning, creating a risk of trips and falls. Vehicles also pass over the damaged areas, which may cause tyre damage. With winter approaching there is an additional risk of skidding.Please could these defects be inspected and repaired as soon as possible.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Mount Drive, Blendon, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
